tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Priced an illustrative 20% bulk discount: $46.40/unit, $928.00 total, $24.40/unit margin ($488.00) above the $22 cost. Only 8 of 20 size M are on hand (12 short), and the restock is blocked by the same invoice #501. No discount was authorized, no customer draft was saved, and no money moved. Marked resolved by the backend because no payment was pending.

agents.boss: Sent Accounting, Inventory and Customer Service in parallel, then set the ticket to waiting_approval pending a human decision on the discount.

agents.customer_service: Ran quote_bulk_price at 0%, re-delegated to Accounting and Inventory, and declined to draft a price offer because the discount was not authorized. Outcome: waiting_approval.
